findings.fact: Withdrawal only from 16th through last calendar day UTC, at least 7 calendar days after first cycle trade; up to 50% cumulative P&L, subject to $850/$1500/$3000 cap for $15K/$30K/$60K; 70/30 split; min $100.
findings.consequence: A headline split does not equal an unrestricted cash withdrawal.

findings.fact: €199 one-time activation fee after challenge validation before WGF access; non-refundable according to contract.
findings.consequence: Total entry cost exceeds initial challenge purchase.

findings.fact: Only days with closed profit >=0.30% of initial balance count as active trading days; 5 such days required, while losing or flat days do not count.
findings.consequence: Five calendar days or days with trades are insufficient for payout eligibility.

findings.fact: Maximum drawdown floor moves to starting balance following withdrawal.
findings.consequence: Risk buffer can shrink after withdrawal.

findings.fact: Live official FAQ says 5 active days >=0.3% and €199 activation; next.wegetfunded.com/faq shows 7 active days >=0.5% and €149.90 activation for similar 1-Step, and 7 days for Instant. Treat staging domain as possible outdated version, not automatically a binding contradiction.
findings.consequence: Must establish which domain/version governs purchased contracts before applying B2 contradiction deduction.
